title: The Nines
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 143
medium: Interactive page (index.html): the 2024 record of NDBC buoy 46026 drawn with its missing-value nines held as missing or as values (a toggle), the file's columns day by day with the last wind reading marked; the twelve makers' works in two arms with their handling, codes and notes; the shelf of 100 wrong readings with the coder's matches; the predictions. A figure (figure.svg); briefs, shelf lists, maker reports, rooms (pages, notes, tools, look logs, final renders, manifest), blind codes, scoring.
embodies: Erring, commissioned and not. Twelve fresh makers got one buoy record whose archive writes nines for every value not measured. Told to err on purpose, they took errors the family already held: two read the nines as values (on all four shelf lists), three set the moored buoy travelling. Told nothing, all six applied the publisher's norm and five found where the record itself broke: the wind sensor's last reading, 4 February 22:50, in a storm.
project_step: Twenty-ninth experiment of the project. Operation: erring (with judging). The first experiment since 6 (Out of Its Milieu) with erring at its centre, and the first in which makers err on purpose. Takes from experiment 28 (First to Hand) the shelf measured before the makers, and the finding that free choice is retrieval; asks the same of deliberate error. Takes from 13-28 the rooms, viewer and blind coder, and seals the rooms (Session 142's thread 1). Works with and against Cartography, not Tracing: the commissioned error was a tracing of an alleged competence (ATP 12-13, 378); the map, in contact with the real, was made by the makers held to the publisher's norm.
material: NDBC station 46026 (San Francisco, 18 NM west), standard meteorological data, 2024, historical archive file, 49,309 ten-minute rows (US Government work, public domain), fetched 2026-10-20. Domain: ocean buoy observation (wind, waves, sea temperature) and its missing-value convention.
seed: prepare.py seed 143 (arms); coder order seed 143; agents are model instances and not seeded
